capture_method.camera_transform: rotate raw pixels 180 degrees; lossless RGB uint8
capture_method.dynamic_visual_fields: Only enumerated FlatStove burner alpha; raw vendor values preserved; per-frame independent qpos predicate check
capture_method.physics_nonmutation: exact before/after live integration state for each isolated snapshot
capture_method.quaternion_canonicalization: frozen verify_snapshot_forward; 1e-12 roundoff bound, exact MuJoCo normalization, all other coordinates unchanged
capture_method.source_action_policy: all approved source actions in exact order; never filter by success or event outcome

launch_gate: Exact initial 200 source IDs plus this contract digest in a separately sealed explicit user approval. No automatic retries.
qualification_limits: New canonical recordings; no claim of historical source scene/observation identity, historical alias closure or M4 novelty.
Independent full-state, geometry/contact, pose and proprioception reconstruction on every frame; no preexisting production baseline.
Three fixed frames per source and two views rerendered. Byte mismatches are preserved and require qualification review; no automatic tolerance or label admission.
Recording consistency does not establish contact/grasp label quality; independent full-episode label QA and prompt admission remain mandatory.
Reserves require a separate coverage admission and may consume only the remaining cumulative 300-source resource budget.

runtime.device: Feifei GPU 0; no concurrent substantial GPU workload
